drawings.description: à gauche de ce carré, un croquis en perspective de l'escalier précédent : un réseau de flèches dont les sommets $e$ sont cerclés, $X$ et $Y$ en bas à gauche, traversé par un trait épais en escalier et par un axe vertical ; on ne le redessine pas.
drawings.notes: The perspective sketch of the staircase: a network of arrows whose e vertices are ringed, crossed by a thick stair-shaped stroke and a vertical axis (pencil). The nodes and principal arrows are placed as on the page; X at the lower left is labelled; the ringed vertex below it (Y according to the transcription) carries no legible letter and is left unlabelled. The two horizontal strokes at the top, the short strokes at the upper right and the thin diagonal are drawn as seen, without interpretation. The transcription chose not to redraw this sketch; it is redrawn here approximately.
